sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the verified COMPLEX_READINESS requirement: applicability is restricted to 20 deg < framingAngle < 70 deg, required owners and relationship paths are preserved, interpolation endpoints and operands are represented, declared units are enforced without guessed datatypes, and formula execution is not incorrectly required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the guessed xsd:decimal constraints from every qudt:numericValue node because the supplied canonical metadata declares no datatype; retain only declared units and required structural constraints. Do not make the conditional requirement universally applicable: remove unconditional sh:minCount 1 from ship-to-obliquePlatingInterpolationCase (and from ship-to-calculationCase unless existence is independently required), so supplied cases are validated without requiring every ship to have them.
